notes: Crowded-room performance stability: manual mode pinning, smoothed FPS switching, reduced idle DrawCharacter overlay sampling and opt-in timing. Deploy only with the matching patched v3.9.40 userscript.

items: Explicit Low CPU and Normal mode selections stop automatic CPU switching and pin the visual profile.
The FPS automatic manager uses longer samples, a rolling median, sustained slow/fast thresholds and switch cooldowns.
Automatic recovery to Normal occurs only if that manager previously enabled Low CPU.
Idle Essentials overlay-position checks run about once every 600 milliseconds per character rather than 100 milliseconds.
Hovering, speech, pet suit and remote emote overlays keep faster checks.
Detailed DrawCharacter timing is collected only during explicit performance sampling; native game drawing still executes on every call.
The direct AssetGet microcache suspends sooner in crowded rooms when repeated lookups are too rare to offset its overhead.
No changes to Echo canvas size, asset data, equipment updates or native game hooks.
